purpose: Define Wisp's pinned, immutable registry for the selected portable workflow schemas and ensure an additive architecture-model revision does not break existing workspace models.
scope: Register requirement@1, research-report@1, spec@1, plan@1, arch-model@1, and arch-model@2 with upstream provenance; expose exact contract identities, canonical locations, and validation; discover the architecture model once using the preferred @2 validator while accepting documents that contain only the prior @1 shape.
non_goals: Supporting arch-audit or unrelated workflow contracts.
Writing or migrating architecture-model documents, backfilling decision_ref, or changing spec-only persistence.
Resolving decision_ref to prove that an ADR exists, is accepted, or governs the invariant.
Inferring the schema version under which a model was authored when its payload contains no version marker.
Replacing the vendored registry with a remote service or contracts package.

api_surface.name: Contract::id
api_surface.description: Returns the exact pinned schema identity for a selected registry contract.

api_surface.name: Contract::canonical_directory
api_surface.description: Returns the workspace-relative directory used for the selected contract.

api_surface.name: Contract::from_id
api_surface.description: Resolves an exact registered contract ID without network access and returns a typed error for an unknown ID.

api_surface.name: validate_contract
api_surface.description: Validates a parsed document against the selected embedded schema.

api_surface.name: discover_graph
api_surface.description: Discovers canonical artifacts read-only and returns each artifact with the contract used to validate it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The repository vendors the selected requirement@1, research-report@1, spec@1, plan@1, arch-model@1, and arch-model@2 schemas byte-for-byte from recorded immutable agent-plugins revisions; each provenance record contains the source path, revision, schema identity, and SHA-256 matching the vendored bytes, and the existing arch-model@1 file is unchanged.
The registry exposes arch-model@2 with id arch-model@2, canonical directory docs/architecture, and validation through the pinned local schema without network access.

A document valid under arch-model@1 but lacking decision_ref validates when Contract::ArchModelV2 is selected; discovery reports that validator through DiscoveredArtifact.contract, does not write or migrate the document, and makes no claim about its authoring version.

Under arch-model@2, decision_ref may be absent or a string; a present non-string decision_ref is rejected by schema validation, while Wisp does not claim that a string reference resolves to an existing or accepted ADR.
The existing arch-model@1 contract identity and exact validator remain available, and validation behavior for requirement@1, research-report@1, spec@1, plan@1, and arch-model@1 remains unchanged.

Graph discovery emits exactly one architecture-model node for docs/architecture/model.json and records arch-model@2 as the validator used, whether the valid document includes decision_ref or uses only the prior @1 shape.

Invalid architecture-model JSON or schema content produces a GraphIssue for the workspace-relative path with field document and no architecture-model node; it does not prevent discovery of independent valid artifacts.
Registry lookup, schema validation, and graph discovery do not modify canonical artifact bytes or Git state.
Contract::from_id resolves every registered exact contract ID and returns ContractLookupError::UnknownContract for an unregistered ID; it performs no filesystem writes.

When a document is validated against a selected registered contract but violates that version's schema, validation returns a typed schema-violation diagnostic identifying the selected contract and does not modify the document.

For every registered contract variant, Contract::id returns the schema's exact $id, Contract::canonical_directory returns its documented canonical directory, and validate_contract accepts a valid fixture for that contract.
